text: Quickstart flow: get an API key, store a memory, and search it back in about five minutes
quote: In about five minutes you will get an API key, store your first memory, and search it back.

text: MCP server exposes memory tools so the agent itself decides when to save, look up, or update memories
quote: The Mem0 MCP server hands your agent a set of memory tools, so it can decide for itself when to save something, look something up, or update what it already knows.

text: Agents can self-provision a Mem0 account and API key with a few terminal commands, no email or dashboard required
quote: Four terminal commands create an account and API key. No email, no dashboard.

text: Open-source Mem0 is the same memory engine as the hosted Platform, deployable on your own infrastructure
quote: Mem0 Open Source is the same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure. You own the stack, the data, and every component

text: Self-hosted Docker bundle ships REST API plus dashboard with per-user API keys and a request audit log
quote: The self-hosted bundle ships the REST API and a web dashboard together... per-user API keys and a request audit log.

text: Store facts once and retrieve them later by query
quote: Store facts once, then retrieve them by query

text: Search lets agents ask natural-language questions and get back the most relevant memories
quote: Mem0's search operation lets agents ask natural-language questions and get back the memories that matter most.

text: Memories are automatically organized into a built-in graph of entities and relationships, no external graph DB to run
quote: Graph Memory is built in. There is no Neo4j, Memgraph, or other graph store to deploy, no connection strings to manage, and nothing to enable.

text: Platform API lets you scope/separate memories by user, agent, and app
quote: Mem0's Platform API lets you separate memories for different users, agents, and apps.

text: Reranking reorders search results using deep semantic understanding to surface the most relevant memories first
quote: Reorders results using deep semantic understanding to put the most relevant memories first.

text: Setting an expiration_date makes a memory stop surfacing after that date without deleting the underlying record
quote: Set an expiration date on a Mem0 memory and it stops surfacing in search once that date passes. Nothing is deleted.

text: Memory Export feature produces structured exports of memories using customizable Pydantic schemas
quote: The Memory Export feature allows you to create structured exports of memories using customizable Pydantic schemas.

text: Webhooks send real-time HTTP notifications when memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized
quote: You can configure webhooks to send HTTP POST requests to your specified URLs whenever memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized.

text: Official CLI supports add, search, list, update, and delete of memories directly from the terminal
quote: The mem0 CLI lets you add, search, list, update, and delete memories directly from the terminal.

text: Documented first-party integration guides for 22 tools including LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and the Vercel AI SDK
quote: Setup guides for 22 tools, including LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and the Vercel AI SDK.

text: Plugins let Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other coding-agent harnesses remember your project
quote: Plugins that let Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other harnesses remember your project.

text: Any MCP-capable AI client can connect to Mem0's hosted MCP server, pointed at with a single command
quote: Connect any AI client to Mem0 using Model Context Protocol in minutes

text: Entity-centric queries like 'what do we know about Alice' pull facts across many conversations from the memory graph
quote: You ask entity-centric questions like "what do we know about Alice?" and expect facts pulled from many different conversations

text: Official SDK offers a simple add(messages, user_id) call to store conversation memory
quote: client.add(messages, user_id="user123")

text: Mem0 automatically extracts individual facts from a conversation and stores each one separately
quote: Mem0 pulls the individual facts out of the conversation and stores each one separately
